  readability, and maintainability.

---

## Description
Provide a clear description of the proposed code improvement.

## Current Implementation
Describe the current implementation and identify its limitations or inefficiencies.

## Proposed Improvement
Explain the proposed changes and how they will improve the existing code.

## Expected Benefits
Select the expected benefits:

- [ ] Improved performance
- [ ] Reduced resource consumption
- [ ] Better code readability
- [ ] Improved maintainability
- [ ] Reduced code duplication
- [ ] Better code structure
- [ ] Other

## Affected Components
List the files, modules, classes, or functions involved.

## Acceptance Criteria
Define the conditions required to consider this improvement complete.

- [ ] Changes are implemented.
- [ ] Existing functionality is preserved.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated, if necessary.

## Additional Context
Add relevant references, code snippets, screenshots, or links to related issues.
